from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single paper in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper itself")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers in the collection that this paper cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
